command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command $existing = @(Get-Process -Name cockpit-tools -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($existing.Count -gt 0) { $p=$existing[0]; if ($p.Path -ne 'C:\Users\PC\AppData\Local\Cockpit Tools\cockpit-tools.exe') { throw 'Unexpected cockpit identity' }; $launched=$false } else { $p=Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Users\PC\AppData\Local\Cockpit Tools\cockpit-tools.exe' -WorkingDirectory 'C:\Users\PC\AppData\Local\Cockpit Tools' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru; $launched=$true }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; $p.Refresh(); [ordered]@{ checkedAt=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); processId=$p.Id; launched=$launched; running=(-not $p.HasExited); executable='C:\Users\PC\AppData\Local\Cockpit Tools\cockpit-tools.exe'; userAuthorizedRestore=$true } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath 'quality/evidence/T30/cockpit-restoration23.json' -Encoding utf8NoBOM; if ($p.HasExited) { throw 'Cockpit restoration exited within8seconds' }; Write-Output 'Cockpit actual running at eight-second check.'
